response.text:
Pricing — Volly

Beta

# Plans and pricing.

Unlimited seats, flat per workspace. Cancel anytime.

## Free

$0forever

Start building with your team. No card required.

- 2 published apps
- 1 resource connection
- Unlimited seats
- Unique subdomain per app
- Google or Microsoft sign-in
- 30-day audit retention

## Team

Beta pricing

$75/mo per workspace

For workspaces that need room to grow and enforced SSO.

- Everything in Free
- Up to 50 published apps
- Up to 20 resource connections
- Unlimited seats
- Enforced SSO
- 1-year audit retention

## Enterprise

Custom

For workspaces that need more than Team.

- Everything in Team
- Unlimited published apps
- Unlimited resource connections
- Custom / unlimited audit retention
- Priority support and onboarding
- Invoice billing and custom terms

## Frequently asked questions

Billing, seats, and what beta pricing covers.

What does beta pricing mean?

Volly is in beta. Team is $75/mo per workspace while we refine the product and pricing. We will give advance notice before any change to your rate.

How are plans billed?

Plans are billed per workspace, not per seat. Every plan includes unlimited seats, so you can invite your whole team under one subscription. Cancel anytime from the billing portal.

What happens when I hit a Free plan limit?

Publishing more apps, adding resource connections, or enabling enforced SSO pauses until you upgrade to Team or free up a slot. Deployed apps and your team’s access keep working either way.

Can I change or cancel later?

Yes. Manage or cancel from Settings → Billing in the app. Cancelling stops renewal; Team features stay active until the end of the period you’ve paid for.

What payment methods do you accept?

Checkout runs on Stripe and accepts major cards. Enterprise customers can pay by invoice; email hello@volly.so.
